thunderstorms 9 miles east of Snowville, moving northeast at 45 mph.
Another areas of storms was 20 miles south of Malta moving
northeast towards Juniper area of Interstate 84 over the next 45
minutes. near

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

unsecured objects.

Preston, Malad, Franklin, Juniper, Pleasantview, Cherry Creek Rest
Area, Holbrook Summit, Dayton, Weston, Clifton, Mapleton, Stone,
Sweetzer Summit, Mink Creek, Samaria, Whitney, Riverdale, and
Holbrook.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRGGW

The National Weather Service in Glasgow has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Daniels County in northeastern Montana...
Northwestern Roosevelt County in northeastern Montana...
Northeastern Valley County in northeastern Montana...

* Until 1045 PM MDT.

* At 938 PM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 7 miles northeast of Richland to 12 miles south of
Peerless to 7 miles north of Lustre to 15 miles northwest of Wolf
Point, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Scobey, Richland, Flaxville, Bredette, Whitetail, Lustre, Madoc,
Peerless, Four Buttes, West Fork, and Volt.
